caption:
Momo is keen to try Pilates, but the ball, ring and band had her puzzled.

A soft, small ball behind your back or between your knees gives you something to feel against. The ring adds light resistance when you squeeze it between your hands or thighs. Bands let you change the challenge just by shortening your grip or swapping colours.

A common myth is that props only make things tougher. Often they make a movement easier to learn first. Pick one prop and learn two or three exercises properly.

Returning after an injury, or pain lasting weeks? Start with an assessment. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio can show you how to use each prop safely. Book online via the link in bio 🐱
